_doc: Window + door product catalog. Hand-edited single source of truth. Generators consume this and emit specs/_partials/window-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_pricing_rule: Windows + doors are quoted as RANGES (custom orders, supplier variance). Each entry has baht_per_unit_min and baht_per_unit_max. Cost rollup sums min and max separately and renders the result as a range. Stock items where the price is firm: set min == max.
_size_convention: size_w_cm × size_h_cm = the window FRAME size (the glass + frame as supplied). Brick-to-brick opening sizes (the actual hole in the wall) are 10–20 mm larger and live in scope-picks.json so each scope can document its specific opening.

framex-sliding-120x110-black.name: FRAMEX sliding window + screen, black
framex-sliding-120x110-black.notes: Standard Thai Watsadu stock size — no custom order needed for the 5 main windows.

framex-awning-bathroom-custom-40x40.name: FRAMEX awning window + screen, black (custom 40×40 cm for bathroom)
framex-awning-bathroom-custom-40x40.notes: No standard awning that small — custom order. Reference link points at the 80×50 stock variant for the product family.

framex-sliding-door-170x195-black-custom.name: FRAMEX sliding door + screen, black (custom ~170×195 cm)
framex-sliding-door-170x195-black-custom.notes: No standard size fits this opening — custom order (สั่งตัด).
